title: One Month In: How to Fix the Budget You Started

lines.say: One month into your new budget, and it didn't go to plan?
Good. That's normal. Month one is for finding out what's true. Here's how to fix it, with real numbers.
Let's review our example from episode one.
Step one. Put planned next to actual.
Here's the month.
Groceries and gas ran one twenty over.
Fun money, sixty over.
Utilities came in thirty under.

lines.cap: And an oil change nobody planned for, $75.
lines.say: And an oil change nobody planned for, seventy-five.
Net, two twenty-five over plan.

scene.label: Reached the credit card this month

lines.cap: That came out of the goal money, so only $132 reached the credit card this month.
lines.say: That came out of the goal money, so only one thirty-two reached the credit card this month.
Step two. Fix the numbers, not yourself.

scene.head: THE FIXES
items: Fun money: $200, on its own card or cash
Car upkeep: +$10 a paycheck to surprise funds
Utilities: leave it; one month isn't a trend

lines.say: Four fixes.

lines.cap: Groceries were planned too low. Make it $700, a number you can actually hit.
lines.say: Groceries were planned too low. Make it seven hundred, a number you can actually hit.

lines.cap: Fun money stays at $200, but it moves to its own card or cash, so you can see it running out.
lines.say: Fun money stays at two hundred, but it moves to its own card or cash, so you can see it running out.

lines.cap: The oil change wasn't a surprise. Add $10 a paycheck to your surprise funds for car upkeep.
lines.say: The oil change wasn't a surprise. Add ten dollars a paycheck to your surprise funds for car upkeep.
And leave utilities alone. One cheap month isn't a trend.

lines.cap: New goal money: $277 a month. Lower than before. But it's real.
lines.say: New goal money: two seventy-seven a month. Lower than before. But it's real.
The perfect plan cleared the card in eight months.
The real plan takes ten, and about sixty dollars more in interest.

scene.text: A budget you keep beats a perfect one you quit.

lines.say: Two extra months beats quitting in February. A budget you keep beats a perfect one you abandon.

scene.cta: Adjust your plan in seconds with the Paycheck Planner: link in the description

lines.say: The Paycheck Planner in the description makes these changes in seconds. Change one number, and everything updates.
Subscribe, and keep going. Month two is easier.
